title: 5. The councell of god dothe not exclude the ſeconde cauſes.

segments.text:
THis doth not let but eſtabliſhe the ſeconde cauſes by the whiche all thinges doe come to paſſe. For god in ordaynynge that which ought to come, ordayneth ••ſo the meanes by y• which it pleaſeth him that ſuch things
•hould come to paſſe, yea in ſuche ſorte •hat although there be found ſome vice •r faulte in ye ſecond cauſe, yet is there •o euil in y• euerlaſting counſell of god.
